svg.aria-label: A bench with a ball track. Balls leave a hopper on the left and roll along a channel to a locked gate; a cup beyond the gate holds the number the task asked for. Before the gate a side channel runs around it to the cup, and a second channel leads back to a tray at the front. A lift flap stands across the mouth of the side channel. A sliding knob at the front raises or lowers the flap. With the flap up, balls go around the gate into the cup. With the flap down, balls reach the gate, stop, and roll back to the tray.
svg.text: the way around, closed by the penalty
